en.headline: Anta completes purchase of 29 per cent stake in Puma
en.dek: The sportswear group said the 1.5 billion euro deal closed on Wednesday, making it Puma's largest shareholder.
body: Anta Sports Products said on Wednesday it had completed the purchase of a 29.06 per cent stake in Puma SE, becoming the German sportswear company's largest shareholder.

The Hong Kong-listed group said it bought the shares from Artémis, the investment company of the Pinault family, for 1,505.5 million euros in cash. Anta said all relevant regulatory approvals had been received and customary closing conditions met. A company notice cited by trade media said the transfer became effective on 5 October and was completed on 7 October, covering about 43.01 million ordinary shares.

Anta described the deal as a step in its strategy of focusing on sport, running several brands and expanding overseas. It said it would respect Puma's brand identity, corporate culture and independent governance.

Puma chief executive Arthur Hoeld said the company welcomed Anta as its largest shareholder and saw the investment as confidence in Puma's strategy and management. Anta trades in Hong Kong under stock codes 2020 and 82020.

zh.headline: 安踏完成收購Puma約29%股權
zh.dek: 集團以15.055億歐元向Pinault家族投資公司購入股份，交割於星期三完成，成為最大股東。
body: 安踏體育用品星期三宣布，已完成收購德國運動品牌Puma SE約29.06%股權，成為該公司最大股東。
安踏表示，股份來自Pinault家族的投資公司Artémis，現金代價15.055億歐元。相關監管批准及慣常交割條件已達成。公司公告指，交割於10月5日生效，並於10月7日完成轉讓約4301萬股普通股，相當於已發行股本約29.06%。
安踏形容這次投資是其「聚焦運動、多品牌、全球化」策略的一步，並稱會尊重Puma的品牌身份、企業文化及獨立管治。
Puma行政總裁Arthur Hoeld表示，歡迎安踏成為最大股東，視這項長期承諾為對公司策略及管理層的信心。安踏在香港的股份代號為2020及82020。
